en: Color postcard showing Sibiu's medieval brick city walls with an arched gate at the base and a round defensive tower with a steep red-tile roof. Leafless trees line a promenade atop/behind the wall; historic houses stand inside the fortifications. A modern lamppost is visible. The reverse has Romanian handwriting, a blue 40 Bani "Posta Romana" stamp, and Sibiu postmarks.
